docs.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Backend Engineer role on Tessel Cargo Software’s Routing & Tracking team. I bring seven years of professional backend experience, primarily building and operating Java and Spring services, with hands-on work in REST APIs, event-driven systems, relational databases, automated testing, and production support.

In my current role at Tejo Insurance Tech, I maintain seven Spring Boot microservices and designed an OpenAPI-versioned partner quoting API used by 12 broker partners. I also produce and consume Kafka events in the claims workflow, where I introduced idempotent consumers and an outbox table to eliminate duplicate claim records. By adding Redis caching and resolving JPA N+1 queries, I reduced quote endpoint p99 latency from 1.8 seconds to 450 milliseconds. I deploy services to AWS EKS with Helm and Jenkins and take part in the on-call rota.

The role’s focus on dependable event ingestion, a reliable customer-facing tracking API, and services that engineers operate closely matches this experience. Tessel’s work turning carrier events into a live picture of shipments makes the team’s event-streaming and reliability challenges especially relevant to the systems I have worked on. My production backend experience is in Java rather than Python, and I can bring the comparable-language experience specified in the role, including Kafka, Docker, AWS, Kubernetes, and automated testing.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience building and running production services could contribute to Tessel’s Routing & Tracking platform.

Sincerely,
Daniel Okafor-Reyes
